batting.dismissal: c K Rabada b Arshdeep Singh

balls.text: taken at backward point, and Ashutosh's cameo comes to an end! Sharp bumper on leg stump that climbs onto Ashutosh and rushes him for pace. He tries to hack it away but the ball is onto him before he can really start his swing. Clinks off the splice and Maharaj dives forward to complete the catch!
full toss speared into the stumps. Brar shuffles across and chalks his attempted scoop. Trickles away behind square on the leg side
full toss on off stump. Ashutosh heaves it away towards deep backward square leg. He will feel he missed out there

looks like a top wide yorker that sneaks just inside the tramlines. Ashutosh left it alone and the umpire was quick to call it a wide. RR have reviewed, though, and they are vindicated. Inside the tramlines, and that is a dot!
this is awesome ball-striking! Boult for the wide yorker but ends up bowling a half-volley. Ashutosh sits deep in his crease and carves it past extra cover!
slower bumper on leg stump. Ashutosh swings himself off his feet and the ball seems to graze the glove. Bounces in front of Samson, though
wide yorker nailed to perfection. Ashutosh goes well across and opens his bat face to guide it down to deep backward point. Retains strike too
what a shot that is! Slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Ashutosh reads the variation like the morning daily and slaps it over long off!

top yorker on middle and off. Ashutosh squeezes it out towards short third man, who lines up a throw at the batter's end and misses by a fair distance. Avesh cannot get there to gather it, and PBKS get an extra run. Jaiswal was the fielder on that occasion
insult to injury! Length on middle and off, and that is right into Ashutosh's arc. Bends his back knee to get under it and mauls it over wide long on!

two fielders go for the same catch again, and this time, RR put it down! Full, angling into the stumps. Ashutosh launches it high up into the air. Just height, no distance. Comes down with rain on it, and Samson goes for the catch along with Avesh. They get in each other's way, and shell the chance
hard length on middle and leg. Brar is cramped for room and pokes it into the mid wicket region
low full toss just outside off. Brar comes forward and drives it towards deep cover point

full on leg stump. Ashutosh tugs it towards deep mid wicket. Livingstone wanted the second but Ashutosh was not as interested. Livingstone has to rush back, and could be in trouble here...In fact, he is indeed an inch short. The throw was not over the stumps but Samson did well to collect it to his left and then flick the ball onto the stumps. Livingstone did seem to take the longer route back to his crease. Either way, this is just what PBKS did not need!
into the stands! A bit of a drag-down outside off and Ashutosh pounces. Opens up his front hip and deposits this over long on!
right up in the blockhole on the pads. Livingstone plays all over it and the ball trickles away towards short third man
length delivery hung up way outside off. Ashutosh tries to drag it leg side but ends up squirting it off the inside edge behind square
darted down leg. Ashutosh has a swing at it and misses. Samson appealed but the umpire called it a wide anyway. Oh dear, looks like Chahal has overstepped too
shortish outside off. Livingstone tries to hit it too hard and chops it past the keeper for a single
slower ball on a length on off. Livingstone plants his front foot and swings it towards deep backward square leg

picks the gap to perfection! Avesh goes for the yorker but errs on the shorter side. Pitches on off and that allows Livingstone to snap his wrists into the stroke. Whips it away perfectly between deep mid wicket and long on!
length on leg stump. Ashutosh tries to help it fine but misses it completely. Deflects off the thigh pad into the on side
slow and short outside off. Livingstone waits for it and dabs it towards backward point
fullish, angling into off stump. Ashutosh comes forward and pokes it past the bowler to get off the mark

soft dismissal! Punjab Kings take a step back after a step forward, again! Hard length outside off. With mid off up, Jitesh thinks he can muscle it over the fielder. The ball, though, gets big on him and he cloths it completely. An easy catch for Parag at mid off, and Avesh is elated. Finishes his celebratory jump right beside Jitesh, who is disappointed at having been dismissed in this fashion!
pick the bones out of this one! Livingstone is up and running! Back of a length outside off. Livingstone picks the length really early and whacks it out of sight over deep mid wicket!
Livingstone finds the fence, finally! Another slot ball, just outside off. Livingstone plants his front foot and mows it over mid wicket!
angled in on a back of a length on leg stump. Livingstone swings at it and misses. Gets pinged on the thigh for his troubles
short outside off. Livingstone lets it go, hoping for a wide but does not get the call. Seemed inside the tramlines, prima facie
back of a length outside off. Jitesh loses his shape while swinging and tugs it towards mid wicket
second six for Jitesh! Right in the slot outside off and Jitesh cashes in. Gets his front foot out of the way, swings through the line and bashes it over the bowler's head!
quicker and flatter on a length on leg stump. Jitesh has an ugly hack at it and squirts it away towards deep backward square leg
gorgeous! Chahal lobs it up on a length outside off, and he gets met. Jitesh reads the flight, comes out of his bunker and creams it over extra cover!
back of a length on off. Livingstone eases it down to long on
fired in full on leg stump. Jitesh gives himself room and powers it to long on
full on leg stump. Livingstone comes forward and knocks it to long on
shortish on off. Jitesh backs away a touch and punches it towards deep cover point
fuller, wider and quicker outside off. Jitesh steps down and drills it to long off
angled in on a length on leg stump. Keeps coming back in with the arm and cuts Jitesh in half as he was trying to go inside out
fired in on a length on middle and leg. Jitesh walks across his stumps and then has a mow across the line. Does not make contact and gets pinged on the forearm
shorter outside off, which allows Livingstone to go deep into his crease. Cuts it towards deep point and picks up a single
length on middle and off. Livingstone comes forward and taps it back to the bowler
back of a length on leg stump. Jitesh lets the ball come to him before stabbing it towards deep mid wicket
fullish on off. Jitesh comes forward and nurdles it into the mid wicket region for a single
back of a length on leg stump. Jitesh stays back and pats it gently towards short mid wicket
back of a length on off. Jitesh goes back and defends
hard length on middle and off. Skids onto Jitesh and he does well to play it with a straight bat. That was bowled at 143.5kph

Samson puts down a tough chance! It could easily have been two in two for Sen. It was bowled on a back of a length outside off. Livingstone nibbled at it with an open bat face and got a healthy nick. Samson sprawled full length to his right but could not make it stick!

Sen breaks through! Banged into the track on off. Sen gets some extra bounce and this gets big on Shashank. He cannot control his pull and miscues it. Spoons up off the higher part of the bat, almost off the sticker, towards deep mid wicket. Jurel makes up ground to his left and completes the catch with minimal fuss. Just when PBKS' innings was threatening to click into gear, they suffer a setback!
darted into the pads. Shashank lets the ball come to him before working it towards deep mid wicket
boundaries like London buses! Almost six overs without it, and now we have two in succession. Maharaj floats it up full and wide, and Shashank crashes it past extra cover for four!
short on middle and off. Jitesh goes back and jabs it out towards deep cover point
full outside off. Shashank gets onto the front foot and drills it towards long off
shorter and angled into leg stump. Jitesh makes room and cuts it towards deep cover point
Jitesh breaks free! Gives it a bit of air on a full length on middle and leg. Jitesh dances down the track and bangs it over the bowler's head!
quicker and flatter on a back of a length on the stumps. Jitesh eases it off the back foot towards long on
full on middle and leg. Shashank comes forward and pushes it down to long on
slowed up beautifully and bowled well outside off. Shashank has a massive swish at it, and the ball and the bat end up in different postcodes
very full on leg stump. Shashank plays all over it and the ball pings off the pads into the off side
101.9kph slider on a shortish length just outside off. Jitesh goes back and jabs it towards deep cover point

slides this down leg. Jitesh does not get bat on it and the umpire does not give it a wide either. Jitesh is not happy with that decision, and has reviewed. Flat line on UltraEdge, and Jitesh gets the wide he was after!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Shashank tucks it off his pads towards deep square leg

huge appeal, not given by umpire Tapan Sharma! Reviewed by RR! Slanted in full on off. Jitesh gets down on one knee and swipes across the line. Does not lay bat on ball (or so it seems) and gets pinned on the front pad. The umpire has a long look at it, and then says no. The key question here is where this ball has struck Jitesh. The impact could be marginally outside. Nothing on UltraEdge. All eyes on Ball Tracking now. The impact is Umpire's Call. The ball was going on to hit off stump but because of the impact, Jitesh survives!
fuller on off. Jitesh lunges forward and defends
pulls his length back after seeing Shashank advance. Does not get to the pitch but manages to chip it over the bowler for a single

Captain Curran perishes too! Drops this shorter on off, and this seems to skid on a touch quicker than Curran expects. Tries to pull it away but gets it right off the bottom part of the bat. Arrows it straight to Jurel at deep mid wicket, and the Punjab Kings slip further into trouble!
back of a length on off. Jitesh knocks it down the ground to long on
shortish just outside off. Curran goes deep into his crease and hacks it towards long on
length just outside off. Curran comes half forward and scuffs it down the ground to long on
dug into the track on leg stump. Jitesh jumps up onto his toes, lifts up his front leg Calypso style and pulls it towards deep backward square leg
short on leg stump. Curran gets inside the line and tucks it off his hips towards deep backward square leg
back of a length on off. Curran gets up on his toes and plays it back to the bowler
back of a length on middle and leg. Curran gets behind the line and pushes it towards mid wicket
hard length just outside off. Cramps Curran for room and he splices it back towards the bowler

oh dear, what has happened there!?! Floated up on a length outside off and this seems to stick in the surface. Bairstow, trying to go inside out, is way too early into the stroke. The ball seems to bounce a tad extra too and hits Bairstow pretty high on the bat. Loops up to extra cover, and Hetmyer makes no mistake. Bairstow's painstaking knock comes to an end. Maiden IPL wicket for Maharaj, and he is thrilled to bits. Not sure the Punjab Kings are, at this stage!
back of a length on middle and off. Bairstow gives himself room and cuts it through point for a couple of runs
shortish on off. Curran gets onto the back foot and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
short outside off. Seems to hold in the surface and Bairstow scuffs it towards extra cover, who then misfields and allows the single
tossed up full on off. Bairstow comes forward and pushes it towards short extra cover
length just outside off. Curran hops back and jabs it towards deep cover point
quicker, bowled at 100.3 kph. Bairstow gets forward to this length ball on off and blocks
slider on a full length on leg stump. Bairstow tries to work to leg but jams it off the inside edge into his pads
slowed up on a length just outside off. Curran presses half forward initially before going back and pushing it to long off

Prabhsimran holes out! Dangles the carrot on a length on middle and off, and Prabhsimran bites. Steps down the track, trying to smash it into next week. He is hitting into the wind, though, and does not get it right out of the middle too. Spoons up off the inside half of the bat and Jurel does the rest at deep mid wicket. Wicket no.198 in the IPL for Yuzvendra Chahal!
floated up full on leg stump. Bairstow nudges it to the bowler's right and picks up a single
shortish on off. Prabhsimran uses the depth of the crease and eases it out to deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery that slides down leg. Some exercise for the umpire
length on leg stump. Prabhsimran uses the angle and tucks it off his pads towards deep backward square leg
shot! Length outside off and Prabhsimran climbs into it this time. Stands up tall and boshes it over mid off. One bounce and into the fence!
very full on off. Prabhsimran has a swing at it but shanks it towards mid on
banged in short, perhaps as a riposte to the batter advancing. Prabhsimran has a massive swipe at it anyway and is beaten for pace
short outside off again. Bairstow chops it towards deep backward point
shortish outside off. Prabhsimran pats it towards cover point and scampers across to the other end
length on the pads. Prabhsimran uses the pace and works it towards deep square leg
length just outside off. Holds in the surface a touch and Prabhsimran plonks it on the bounce to mid off
length on middle and off. Swings back in and Bairstow presents the full face of the bat, pushing it to mid off
back of a length just outside off. Prabhsimran hangs back and dabs it towards backward point. Bairstow senses an opportunity for a single and takes it
fullish on middle and off. Prabhsimran is caught on the crease and prods it into the off side
length ball shaping into leg stump. Prabhsimran presses half forward and stabs it towards mid on
fullish outside off. Prabhsimran gets onto the front foot and drives it on the up towards mid off for a single
back of a length just outside off. Prabhsimran waits in his crease and defends

Samson and Sen almost collide, but the latter holds on! Hard length, just outside leg. Follows Taide as he tries to back away. He then has a hack across the line but the lack of room means that the ball goes straight up off the top edge. Samson calls but Sen at short third man, does not seem to pay heed. In the end, the ball nestles into Sen's palms. Avesh, well, he was not best pleased. RR, remember, did something similar last year, when three fielders went for the same ball, only for none of them to catch it and for the ball to pop into Boult's hands eventually!
length just outside off. Bairstow has a waft at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
hard length on off. Nips back in and goes past Bairstow's swipe. Thuds into the thigh pad
full and pushed into middle and off. Bairstow comes forward and plays it back to the bowler
full and wide outside off. Bairstow reaches out for it and clinks it towards extra cover
banged into the track outside off. Sails over Taide's head and Samson does well to leap up and get a glove to it. Just a couple of extras
length on leg stump. Seems to hold in the surface just a shade as Bairstow taps it towards mid wicket
shot! Goes for the in-swinging yorker on off stump but over-pitches. Bairstow gets his hands through the ball and cracks it back past Boult!
back of a length just outside off. Bairstow hangs back, uses the pace and dabs it down to short third man
hard length, slanting into middle and off. Cramps Taide for room and he stabs it off the back foot towards mid on
length just outside off. Taide presses half forward and defends
another short ball well outside off. Taide gets on top of the bounce and cuts it towards deep point
short and wide outside off. Bairstow rolls his wrists and cuts it towards deep backward point
full outside off again. Taide punches it towards extra cover, who fumbles and Taide can get across for a single
back of a length on leg stump. Taide gets up on his toes and works it past mid wicket. The fielder, in giving chase, misfields and concedes the second. Chahal the guilty party
four more! Full and too much width on offer, at least from RR's perspective. Taide leans into it and threads it between extra cover and cover point!

Taide welcomes Sen with a boundary! Width outside off and that is one of Taide's favourite strokes. Transfers his weight forward, gets on top of the bounce and laces his square drive past cover point!
hard length on off. Taide, having taken a step down the track, plays all over it and gets rapped on the thigh pad. Ball rolls away for a leg bye
finally some swing! Back of a length outside off and this shapes away nicely. Does so late too and breezes past Taide's outside edge as he pokes at it
full on off. Goes on with the angle. Bairstow drops it into the off side and hares across to the other end
back of a length just outside off. A hint of shape back into Bairstow as he defends into the off side
fullish outside off. Taide gets forward confidently and pushes it enough to mid off's right to get off the mark
angled in on a length on middle and leg. Taide comes half forward and turns it towards mid wicket
speared down leg first up. Taide does not make contact and the umpire calls it a wide. Boult was probably expecting it to swing but it did not do much

A rank full toss, and Hetmyer wins it for RR in pristine style! Thigh-high full toss on leg stump, and that is just what Arshdeep would not have wanted to bowl. Hetmyer cannot believe the freebie he has been served up and swings it away merrily over fine leg! What an ending, and Hetmyer, who has barely batted this season, stood up when the big moment came calling!
dug into the track on off stump. Hetmyer swats it towards long on, where PBKS captain Curran misfields and allows Hetmyer to get back on strike

has that hit the cushion on the full?! Arshdeep misses the yorker by just a smidgen, and Hetmyer climbs into it. Takes a step down the track and clubs it down the ground. Hits the cushion on the full, and that is an enormous moment in the game!
another top yorker outside off. Hetmyer has a massive swing at it but only jams it off the inside edge into his body. Another dot
nails the wide yorker first up! Excellently executed. Right under the bat, and Hetmyer cannot make any contact. Just a fresh-air shot

straight to long on! PBKS keep chipping away! Slower ball bowled right into the slot outside off. Maharaj gets his front foot out of the way and slugs at it. The bat turns upon impact, though, and he chunks it off the inside half of the bat towards long on. Livingstone makes no mistake this time, and RR need ten off the final over!
full on middle and leg. Hetmyer comes forward and tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Maharaj waits for it and runs it down to third man to get off the mark

edged and taken! Powell perishes! Banged in short outside off. Powell, rather than trying to hit it for six, tries to help it. Cannot get on top of it, though, and all he does is feather it through to Jitesh. Has he done his job, though? Either way, this was a cameo RR really needed!
Powell goes bang bang now! RR well in the ascendancy! Full and hung well outside off. Powell does not only reach it, he generates enough power to beat deep cover point to his right!
Powell power! Right in the slot outside off. Powell bends his back knee, gets close to the ball and blasts it to long off's left!

Hetmyer goes big now! Shimron Hetmyer has come to the party! Another short ball, and the problem here is that this is on leg stump. Hetmyer hops inside the line, lifts up his front leg Calypso style and helps it over deep backward square leg!
Hetmyer gets a boundary away! Dug in short on middle and off. Hetmyer picks the length early, opens up his stance and muscles it to long on's left!
full and angling into the pads. Powell flicks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length outside off. Powell waits for it and dabs it past backward point. Scampers back for two and makes it comfortably

another miscue, and another catch in the deep! Sensational catch by Shashank! Hard length on middle and leg. Skids onto Jurel and rushes him on the pull. Does not middle it at all and he cloths it towards deep mid wicket. Shashank tears in from the fence, slides forward and gobbles up the chance! RR's chase is flagging!
full and wide outside off. Hetmyer reaches out for it and drives it towards extra cover. Harshal has gotten away with this. Mid off and extra cover were in the ring

edged and taken! Jurel does not think so, and he reviews! Back of a length on middle and leg. Goes on with the angle and squares up Jurel. He seems to play down the wrong line, and the ball seems to flick the back thigh on the way through. The third umpire takes one replay to decide that it has not hit the pad. Now, as per protocol, they check the lbw. Pitched well outside leg, and Jurel stays!
back of a length on middle and leg. Hetmyer pushes it towards deep mid wicket and gets off the mark

gets the height, but not enough distance! Another twist in this tale! Dug in short on off. Parag thinks he can smash this into the stands but the ball does not arrive as quickly as he expects. Miscues it and the ball goes miles up towards deep mid wicket. Rabada settles under it and snares the chance!

excellent fielding! Off-pace on a length outside off. Parag has an agricultural hack at it and squirts it off the inside edge past short fine. Harpreet Bhatia puts on his skates, puts in the dive and saves two

top edge, and this goes all the way! Pace on, bowled shorter on off stump. Parag tries to demolish it over deep square but ends up getting a top edge. Thankfully for him, it hurtles over the keeper's head, and beyond the fence!
back of a length just outside off. Zips off the surface and whistles past Parag's bat as he looks to swipe it away
safe! Off-pace on a back of a length on leg stump. Holds in the surface and Parag is early into the stroke. Flies off the leading edge and goes past Curran on his follow-through
off-pace on a full length on middle and leg. Jurel pokes it towards deep mid wicket

dropped, oh dear! Hard length on middle and off. Parag does not have enough room to free his arms. Gets the power but not the elevation. Smashes it towards Livingstone at long on. He dives forward but the ball pops out of his hands
back of a length outside off. Jurel dabs it towards short third man, who misfields. Does not concede the second run, though
back of a length on leg stump. Parag drops it into the on side. They briefly contemplate the idea of a second before deciding against it
fullish on middle and off. Jurel comes forward and pushes it towards mid off for a single
shortish outside off. Parag stands up tall and punches it powerfully past extra cover for a couple of runs
marginally short on off. Jurel rocks back and pulls it towards deep mid wicket, who is stationed straighter than usual
full on leg stump. Parag comes forward and eases it towards deep mid wicket
gets it over! Width outside off and that is asking for trouble with backward point and third man up. Parag gives it the lot and scythes it over backward point!
back of a length on leg stump. Jurel stabs it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on off. Jurel comes half forward and defends
back of a length just outside off. Parag hangs back and defends
back of a length in the channel. Straightens a shade and squares up Jurel. Fiddles at it and edges it down to third man
back of a length just outside off. Jurel drops it into the off side and sets off for the single, only to be sent back by Parag
welcomes Jurel with a bumper. On middle and leg, and Jurel does well to get out of the way

big appeal, and given! Rabada has another, and this is a massive moment in the game! Hard length on off, and this cuts back in. Keeps low too and goes under Samson's attempted pull. Gets pinned on the back leg, and umpire Anil Chaudhary raises his finger. Samson has a quick chat with his partner and then reviews. This could be more in hope than expectation. And that is vindicated. Ball Tracking reckons the ball would have smashed into middle and leg, and Samson has to go. Takes a review along with him too!
shortish outside off. Parag stands tall and runs it down to third man
back of a length just outside off. Parag waits for it and knocks it down to long off
fuller and wider outside off. Samson eases it out towards deep cover point
back of a length on middle and leg. Parag stays back and works it towards deep mid wicket
length on off. Samson opts to stay back and punches it enough to extra cover's left for a run
length on middle and off. Parag presses forward and turns it towards deep mid wicket
angled in full on middle and off. Parag comes forward and blocks

length on off. Nips back sharply into Parag and takes the inside edge. Loops up off the thigh pad into the on side. Samson calls for the single and Parag responds. Single completed comfortably in the end

searing yorker on middle and off. Parag picks it just in time and seems to chunk it off the inside edge into his pads. Rabada, though, reckons this has hit the pad first, and talks his captain into reviewing it. Parag has absolutely smashed that into his boot, and PBKS burn a review, just like that!

Rabada gets rid of Jaiswal! Short, wide and this is there to be hit. Jaiswal throws the kitchen sink at it but it perhaps comes off the toe-end. Arrows towards Harshal at third man, and that is just the breakthrough the Kings would have wanted at this stage!
almost! Hard length just outside off. Jaiswal has a jab at it and it squirts off the inside edge, flashing past the stumps
in the slot just outside off. Jaiswal plants his front foot and drills it straight to mid off
back of a length on the pads. Samson uses the angle and glances it down to fine leg
back of a length outside off. Spins away and Samson plays with the turn to deep cover point

has Jaiswal been run out at the bowler's end?! Shortish outside off. Sticks in the surface and Samson hacks it back towards the bowler. Hits the bowler's end stumps thereafter, and Livingstone is happy to admit that the ball has not brushed his finger. We still go upstairs, only to come to that conclusion after watching two or three replays!
four more for Samson! This is shorter and outside off, which gives Samson the room he wants. He rocks back and pummels it between deep mid wicket and long on!
angled in full on the pads. Jaiswal works it towards deep mid wicket
shorter on middle and off. Skids onto Samson and he cloths his pull towards long on
Samson breaks the shackles! Floated up into the slot on off, and Samson takes full toll. Plants his front foot, swings through the line and pumps it over the bowler's head!
back of a length outside off. Samson waits in his crease and punches it towards deep cover point
back of a length on off. Jaiswal hangs back and pushes it towards deep mid wicket
fired in on a length on leg stump. Jaiswal nudges it into the vast open square leg region. Samson calls for two and Jaiswal makes it, despite a sharp throw by Harshal
length ball angled across the batter outside off. Jaiswal hops back and cuts it past point for a couple of runs
short on off. Samson rocks onto the back foot and pulls it towards deep mid wicket
shortish on leg stump. Jaiswal eases it out to deep mid wicket
off-spinner on a length on off. Jaiswal lunges forward and pokes it to long on
length just outside off. Samson chooses to go back and pushes it to long off to get off the mark
shorter outside off. Samson waits in his crease and dabs it towards short third
very full outside off. Samson reaches out for it and digs it out towards point

cleans him up! Fizzed through full on leg stump. Kotian comes down the track, aiming for the moon. Does not account for the spin and seems to play down the wrong line too. Swishes at thin air and hears the death rattle soon after! A 31-ball 24 is perhaps not what RR would have wanted from Kotian, but he has ensured RR have a good base to operate from!
very full on leg stump. Kotian has a swing at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads
slower ball on a length outside off. Kotian tugs it past the bowler and picks up a single
short and wide outside off. Kotian gives it the lot and razes it towards deep cover point. Rabada skips around to his left and cuts it off via a dive
hard length on leg stump. Jaiswal tucks it off his hips towards deep mid wicket

that will technically go down as a drop! Back of a length outside off. Kotian stands up tall and smashes it back at Harshal, who gets in the way but does not really get close to catching it. That was hit very hard
slower bumper outside off. Jaiswal waits for it and helps it towards short fine leg
full outside off. Kotian scuffs it towards mid off and sets off for the single. Has to put in the dive and makes it, helped by Curran missing his shy at the bowler's end

oh dear! Full on middle and leg. Jaiswal stretches forward and flicks it towards deep mid wicket. A bit of yes and no between the batters for the second run but it does not matter in the end because Shashank misfields, and lets in the boundary. He went for a one-handed pick-up and came up second best!
leg-spinner to Jaiswal too. Slides down leg, though, and called a wide
shortish outside off. Kotian stands tall and punches it towards deep cover point
floated up on a length outside off. Kotian has a huge swipe across the line but makes no contact
leg-spin again, on a length just outside off. Kotian is caught on the crease and defends
another leg-spinner, perhaps a touch shorter and wider outside off. Kotian swishes at it and only swats away a few flies in the process
leg-spinner on a back of a length just outside off. Kotian jabs at it and edges it down to short third man
back of a length outside off, bowled at 144.6kph. Jaiswal goes feeling for it away from his body and sees the ball sneak past the outside edge
length outside off. Jaiswal comes forward and opens his bat face to guide it past short third for a couple of runs
length delivery slanted across the batter outside off. Jaiswal throws his hands at it but only connects with fresh air
back of a length on leg stump. Kotian drops it into the on side and saunters across to the other end
hard length on off. Tucks up Kotian for room and he can only defend
disdainful! In the slot, angling into the pads. Kotian gets his front foot out of the way and smacks it over mid on!
back of a length on off. Jaiswal lets the ball come to him before pushing it towards cover
sharp bumper on off stump. Sails over the batter's head, though, and called a wide for height
goes straighter, on a back of a length on the pads. Kotian works it towards mid wicket
another play and miss! Back of a length in the channel. Nips away just a smidgen and that is enough to take it past Kotian's outside edge
fullish just outside off. Kotian has a waft at it with minimal footwork and sees the ball breeze past his flailing blade
length on middle and leg. Jaiswal presses half forward and stabs it towards deep mid wicket
splits the gap! Marginally short outside off. Jaiswal stays back, stays leg side and carves it between short third and backward point!
up and over! Banged into the track on off stump. Sits up for Kotian and he obliges by pounding it over mid wicket!
short ball that slides down leg. Jaiswal helps it round the corner but Brar dives to his left at short fine leg and saves three
length outside off. Kotian stands tall and drives on the up towards short extra cover. Livingstone misfields and ends up conceding a single
shortish on middle and leg. Jaiswal pulls it away towards deep square leg
back of a length on leg stump. Jaiswal gets inside the line and glances it towards deep backward square leg
that has gone to the fence like a tracer bullet! Slower ball that lands right in the slot outside off. Jaiswal plants his front foot and crrunncheesss it past extra cover!
slow and short outside off. Jaiswal laces his cut but cannot get it past the fielder at cover point. Gets a single off a misfield
slower delivery dug into the track on off stump. Jaiswal makes room for himself and jabs it towards extra cover
length on middle and leg. Jaiswal gets a half stride in and pats it towards mid on
another slower ball, on a length on leg stump. Kotian is early into the stroke and plonks it towards mid on for a single
off-pace on a length on the stumps. Grips a little and deviates away. Kotian nibbles at it and gets an outside edge that dribbles towards Jitesh
hard length, shaping into middle and leg. Kotian is cramped for room and plays it back to the bowler
oh! Full in the channel just outside off. Nips away with the angle and Jaiswal, who fishes at it, is beaten comprehensively on the outside
shot! Half-volley on the pads, and that is a help-yourself ball. Jaiswal springs forward and clips it off his pads past mid wicket!

length on middle and off. Kotian tips it to mid off and dashes across to the other end. A direct hit and it might have made things interesting. Replays show Kotian would have made it, even with a direct hit
length just outside off. Kotian comes half forward and clinks it off the toe-end towards cover point
hard length on off. Kotian has a stab at it and chunks it off the inside half of the bat into the on side
fullish just outside off. Holds in the surface and Kotian drives it slightly uppishly towards mid off
back of a length outside off. Kotian gets on top of the bounce and punches it neatly towards deep cover point
off the mark in style! Too much width outside off and Kotian capitalises. Rises with the bounce, opens his bat face and steers it to backward point's left!
length on middle and off. Kotian presses half forward and defends
length on middle and off. Kotian comes half forward and pushes it towards mid off
back of a length delivery on leg stump that swings further down leg. Called a wide
back of a length on off. Shapes away and Kotian does well to cover it and defend
short and wide outside off. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and cuts it towards cover point, who dives over it. Enough time for Jaiswal to get back for three
